_comment: Competition logos, one per section key (see SECTIONS in scripts/build.mjs). Run: node scripts/fetch-logos.mjs [--force] [key ...]. It downloads each url once to assets/logos/ and records file and retrievedAt here. Logos are trademarks of their owners and are used only to identify the competition. "chip": "dark" is for logos drawn in white, which show on a dark backing instead of the default white one. "groups" holds the larger icon in each group header; "chip" can be dark, purple or navy; "crop": "ball" shows only the top of the image.

wales.source: UEFA's own CDN: the association crest the UEFA match feed links for Wales

internationals.source: UEFA's own CDN: UEFA Nations League (competition 2014 in the UEFA match feed)

cymru-north.source: faw.cymru: Cymru Leagues logo from the site header

welsh-cup.source: faw.cymru: FAW crest from the site header (the Welsh Cup pages show no separate cup logo)

premier-league.source: ESPN's CDN: English Premier League logo (league id 23)

championship.source: ESPN's CDN: English League Championship logo (league id 24)

league-one.source: ESPN's CDN: English League One logo (league id 25)

fa-cup.source: ESPN's CDN: FA Cup logo (league id 40)

fa-trophy.source: thefa.com: The FA crest (no separate FA Trophy logo is published on the site)

champions-league.source: UEFA's own CDN: UEFA Champions League (competition 1 in the UEFA match feed)

europa-league.source: UEFA's own CDN: UEFA Europa League (competition 14 in the UEFA match feed)

International.source: faw.cymru: FAW crest (the Wales icon: leads to Wales men's and the other internationals)

Welsh.source: faw.cymru: Cymru Leagues logo (leads to the Welsh domestic fixtures)

English.source: ESPN's CDN: Premier League logo, white version (leads to the English domestic fixtures)

European clubs.source: UEFA's own CDN: Champions League logo, white version, cropped to the starball (leads to the European club fixtures)
